findings.title: Light-theme color for `.topic-meta-data h5 a` changed from 30% to 70% lightness
findings.body: The original rule was `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%)`. The new rule is `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 30%))`. The light-theme branch should keep 30% and the dark branch should use 70%. The PR instead copied the 70/30 pair from the neighbouring `.username.new-user a` rule. Embedded-post author links on light themes become much paler, which is a visible regression and contradicts the PR's purpose of changing only dark-theme behaviour.

findings.title: `.group-member-info .name` light-theme color changed from 30% to 50%
findings.body: The original color was `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%)`. The new rule uses `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 50%))`. The light branch moved from 30% to 50%, so group member names lose contrast on light themes. The correct pair is `30%` / `$secondary 70%`. The `.title` rule below uses 50% and the `.name` rule appears to have been copy-pasted from it.

findings.title: `.custom-message-length` light-theme lightness flipped from 70% to 30%
findings.body: The original was `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%)`, a pale hint color. The new rule is `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 70%))`. The light branch is now 30%, which makes the text much darker than before. The dark branch is also inverted. It should be `$primary 70%` / `$secondary 30%`, matching the desktop `.custom-message-length` rule. The values appear to be swapped, which changes the light theme.

findings.title: `.topic-map h3` light-theme color changed from 20% to 50% lightness
findings.body: The original was `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 20%)`. The new rule is `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 50%))`. The mobile topic-map headings become noticeably lighter on light themes. The correct pair is `$primary 20%` / `$secondary 80%`, as used for `.number, i` in the same block and for the desktop `.topic-map h3`.

findings.title: Mobile `.group-member-info .name` light-theme color changed from 30% to 50%
findings.body: The original was `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%)`. The new rule is `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 50%))`. This changes the light-theme appearance, which should not happen in a dark-theme fix. It should be `$primary 30%` / `$secondary 70%`. The same copy-paste error appears in `desktop/user.scss`.

findings.title: Remaining `scale-color($primary, $lightness: ...)` not converted
findings.body: `.topic-list.categories .category .badge-notification` still uses `color: scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%)`. It is not wrapped in `dark-light-choose` like the other 50% greys in this file. On dark themes this text will still be a dim color derived from `$primary`, so the PR's stated goal is not fully met for this file. The same pattern remains in other places the PR did not touch, such as `mobile/compose.scss` `#file-uploading`, which uses `$secondary` unconditionally.
